continuity.arc_goal: Implement linked workflows with complete lifecycle management: MVP (create/complete/cancel/remove), post-MVP (LinkCommand with deferred completion, onCompleted handler design for VOs, bidirectional link records, purge guard, cross-partition cleanup, cycle prevention). Feature complete with clean commits.

progress_update.summary: We implemented the LinkCommand handler and LinkedNotification handler, replacing the todo!() stubs. Added two integration tests (happy path + rejection), addressed all code review findings, and removed dead ChildOf-write code from the AttachInvocation path. Then designed the onCompleted handler feature for VOs — iterated through several design simplifications including new link types (LinkRelation/ChildStatus replacing EdgeLabel/LinkState), storing handler name on ParentOf record instead of response sinks, and eliminating sink removal entirely.
progress_update.goal: Linked workflows with lifecycle management: bidirectional links, purge guard, cross-partition cleanup, cycle prevention, LinkCommand with deferred completion, and onCompleted handler design for VOs.
accomplished: Implemented on_linked_notification handler: Ok delivers SDK completion via InvocationResponse, Err deletes ParentOf and delivers error completion
Fixed workflow duplicate rejection path to send LinkedNotification Err for Link sinks instead of going through send_response_to_sinks
Added CommandType::Link to OnNotifyInvocationResponse for journal completion delivery
Removed dead ChildOf write from handle_attach_invocation_request, updated tests to use direct insert_incoming_link helper
Designed onCompleted handler feature with simplified architecture: handler name on ParentOf record, fired from on_link_completion_notification, no sink changes needed
progress_update.now: Completed plan review of vo_child_link_on_completed.md design doc. All review findings addressed and doc updated. Ready for implementation.
next_steps: Implement onCompleted: refactor EdgeLabel+LinkState → LinkRelation+ChildStatus, add completion_handler_name to LinkCommand, emit handler invocation from on_link_completion_notification
Add ServiceInvocation::internal_handler_invocation factory method, fix HandlerInvocation sink failure encoding to use proto-encoded Failure
Consider squashing linked-workflows branch commits before merge to main
SDK implementation: TypeScript/Java/Python support for linkWorkflow/removeLink/onCompleted
constraints: LinkRelation key_byte() must match existing EdgeLabel::as_key_byte() for RocksDB prefix scan compatibility
ChildOf records carry no state — type system enforces this via LinkRelation::ChildOf having no fields
CompletionHandlerName lives only in ChildStatus::Running — consumed at Running→Completed transition
No server-side validation of VO-only for completion_handler_name — SDK controls the API surface
Handler argument encoding: Success = raw output bytes, Failure = proto-encoded Failure message bytes
edge_label is part of RocksDB key for directed prefix scans
are_linked does two point reads (ParentOf + ChildOf)
VO clear state only deletes ParentOf links, preserves ChildOf
Check-before-write on ChildOf in AttachInvocation prevents race condition overwrite
Direct cycles prevented by key collision; transitive cycles not detected
Cross-partition links from day one — all link operations use outbox messages
Only workflows can enter Completing — VOs complete immediately regardless of links
Links keyed by (local_service_id, remote_service_id, edge_label) with edge_label in key
HandlerInvocation creates Exclusive handler invocation on parent VO
decisions: Store completion_handler_name on ParentOf record, not on response sinks — eliminates sink removal, RemoveParentLink changes, and send_response_to_sinks modifications entirely
Type refactoring: EdgeLabel+LinkState → LinkRelation(ParentOf(ChildStatus)|ChildOf) + ChildStatus(Running(Option<CompletionHandlerName>)|Completed(ResponseResult))
ChildStatus::complete() method for state transition — consumes Running, yields Completed + handler name by ownership
ServiceInvocation::internal_handler_invocation factory — shared between HandlerInvocation sink and on_link_completion_notification
Fix HandlerInvocation sink to pass proto-encoded Failure instead of Bytes::new() — unreleased code, no backward compat concern
No VO-only validation at server level — SDK controls which parent types can set completion_handler_name
EdgeLabel::ParentOf/ChildOf enum with local_service_id/remote_service_id naming
are_linked(a, b) checks both directions — used for cycle prevention in CreateLink
VO clear state preserves ChildOf records — only deletes outgoing ParentOf links and notifies children
Removed label field entirely — links identified by child_service_id, not arbitrary label string
Extracted cancel_linked_children helper used by cancel (Invoked/Suspended/Paused + Completing) and kill (Completing)
Link barrier check moved outside sinks/retention guard — workflows always enter Completing with running links
No active_children_count — query link table for Running links instead of maintaining denormalized counter
Completion delivers Result<T, E> only — no status field, no inline frozen graph
Completing variant carries InFlightInvocationMetadata + buffered ResponseResult
RemoveLink included in MVP — graph curation is load-bearing
End-to-end integration test included in MVP scope
Cancellation is local per node — each node cancels its own direct children
HandlerInvocation targets VirtualObjectHandlerType::Exclusive — handler runs under object's exclusive lock
CreateLink proto uses result_completion_id field (not RawCommand metadata) matching AttachInvocation pattern
Lite decoding for CreateLink/RemoveLink returns graceful DecodingError — DataFusion skips these entries
